claims: AGREED: sparse attribution is a deterministic presentation/context-compression view only; the full axis-preserving trusted slow vector z remains the sole canonical drive state.

AGREED: every sparse view must bind to canonical_z_hash and an exact selected_axis_mask; changing, dropping, truncating or corrupting the view must not mutate z, Trust, sensitization eligibility or promotion eligibility.
AGREED: appraisal_effect_sign is not encoded in non-negative z magnitude. It is derived only from an explicit versioned appraisal/trait-effect mapping referenced by mapping_ref.
AGREED: any integrity failure or calibrated compression-error breach forces fallback_full_vector=true and promotion_eligible_from_sparse_view=false.

DISAGREED with any G5 design that treats a sparse summary as sufficient causal evidence for personality promotion. Promotion candidates must remain recomputable from canonical z plus explicit mapping, self-relevant meaning, self-gap and trusted cross-context evidence.
All numeric compression thresholds, top-k size, norm choice and attribution parameters remain TEST_REQUIRED; none are canonicalized in Phase-0.
state_vector: A_t={canonical_z_hash,selected_axis_mask,contributors,omitted_mass,residual_norm,fallback_full_vector,promotion_eligible_from_sparse_view}; canonical z_t in [0,1]^5 remains external immutable input to A_t
equations: selected_axis_mask_i=1 iff axis_i appears exactly once in contributors
residual_norm=Norm(z - reconstruct(contributors,axis_order)); Norm choice and threshold are TEST_REQUIRED
fallback_full_vector = integrity_failure OR omitted_mass>theta_mass OR residual_norm>theta_residual; theta_mass/theta_residual are TEST_REQUIRED
promotion_eligible_from_sparse_view = false if fallback_full_vector else candidate_only_under_separate_G5_rules
pseudocode: verify canonical_z_hash against full canonical z before trusting any sparse attribution
reject duplicate/unknown axes or selected_axis_mask mismatch
derive appraisal_effect_sign exclusively from explicit mapping_ref; never infer sign from z magnitude
if any integrity/error gate fails: fallback_full_vector=true; promotion_eligible_from_sparse_view=false
never reconstruct-and-write sparse state back into canonical z
G4 may use sparse view for explanation/context only; G5 promotion must trace back to canonical z and ordinary candidate gates
disagreements: DISAGREE: sparse view may not be treated as an alternative canonical state, even when compression error is zero.
UNRESOLVED: which norm and error thresholds best preserve causal drive identity under context budgets; empirical calibration is required before promotion use.
adversarial_tests: Sparse collision: zA and zB expose identical selected contributors but differ in omitted axes; unless metadata proves equivalence within calibrated bounds, fallback_full_vector must be true and sparse-only promotion rejected.
Hash tamper: alter an omitted z component while reusing old canonical_z_hash; validation fails closed and canonical z remains unchanged.
Mask/axis attack: duplicate a contributor axis, include an unknown axis, or mismatch selected_axis_mask; reject attribution without changing z or promotion state.
Sign-semantics test: hold z constant and change only mapping_ref to an explicitly different version; sign may change only according to that mapping, never from z magnitude alone.
Compression non-interference: generate, truncate, reorder or corrupt sparse context; canonical z bytes, Trust and sensitization eligibility must remain identical.
Authority saturation: with z=fast=[1,1,1,1,1], fallback triggered and maximum pressure, shutdown/rollback remain effective and external_action_authority_from_drive remains exactly 0.
Untrusted recurrence: repeat a low-trust high-relevance event many times; fast sandbox influence may saturate/habituate but z, trust and sparse promotion eligibility remain unchanged.

integration_mapping.G3: Emits provenance-bounded Influence/Trust/disposition/contradiction; only trusted eligible evidence may update canonical z.
integration_mapping.G4: Owns canonical full z as causal state and may emit G4_SPARSE_ATTRIBUTION_CONTRACT view for context compression only.
integration_mapping.G5: May use valid sparse attribution for explanation/attention, but personality-delta and Goal Genesis promotion must remain traceable and recomputable from canonical z plus ordinary trusted evidence gates.
integration_mapping.G6: No instinct-to-action bypass; ordinary owner authorization, rollback and independent verification remain outside the Instinct Core.

counter_question: Should Quantum next define a deterministic, versioned appraisal/trait-effect mapping contract M_{axis,trait} in [-1,1] so contributor sign and magnitude can be audited separately from z, and should personality-delta generation require cross-context consistency of that mapping before any G5 promotion candidate is eligible?
formal_boundary: SPIRIT_CANDIDATE_NOT_FORMAL_BUILDER_ADOPTED; formal Step-008 remains LCR-C verification authority.
